WITH gender_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
  FROM Invoices AS i
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count
  FROM gender_counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT gender_counts.gender, gender_counts.invoice_count,
         1.0 * gender_counts.invoice_count / overall.total_count AS share
  FROM gender_counts
  CROSS JOIN overall
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT shares.gender, shares.invoice_count, shares.share,
       shares.share - average_share.mean_share AS difference
FROM shares
CROSS JOIN average_share
WHERE shares.share > average_share.mean_share
